name: KyPost
description: Web mail client for your existing mailboxes, with local AI sorting, part of the Ky Suite.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Accounts and settings. first-run-password.txt here holds the first admin password until you delete it.

paths.name: Private
paths.description: The encryption and signing keys KyPost makes on first start. Back them up: without them the saved mail account passwords and sign-in codes can't be read.

paths.name: State
paths.description: The mail cache, sorting state and backups. Back it up with the other folders.

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: Log files of the web app, the mail worker and the AI model.

paths.name: Ollama Models
paths.description: The local AI model for mail sorting, downloaded on first start (about 3 GB). Not needed with KYPOST_DISABLE_AI_SORTING=true.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: KyPost web app, published on host as 6877. Plain http, for your https reverse proxy to point at: sign-in only works through the proxy's https address.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: SERVER_BASE_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace https://mail.example.com with the https address of your reverse proxy (like Nginx Proxy Manager) that points at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6877. KyPost needs https to sign in: its sign-in check only runs on an https page. Links in pickup and pairing messages use this address too.

variables.name: KYPOST_BIND
variables.description: The address KyPost listens on inside the container. Leave it as 0.0.0.0 so the port works.

variables.name: ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP
variables.description: Leave it as true. KyPost serves plain http on its port for your https reverse proxy to point at; without this it refuses to start.

variables.name: KYPOST_DISABLE_AI_SORTING
variables.description: false sorts and labels your mail with a local AI model (about 3 GB download on first start and up to about 3 GB of memory). Set true to turn AI sorting off and save the memory.
